card.text: Explore Belinda through its published prolate shape model.

introduction.text: Belinda is an elongated inner moon of Uranus, discovered in Voyager 2 images in 1986. Its changing brightness supports a shape about twice as long as it is wide. It travels around Uranus in roughly fifteen hours.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Shape estimated from Voyager and Hubble observations. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no imagery.
